title: SK-II Facial Treatment Essence 75ml
description_en: The legendary SK-II essence containing 90%+ Pitera — a bio-fermented ingredient discovered in Japanese sake breweries. Renews skin texture and radiance with consistent use. A luxury staple since 1980.
